# Cleveland Clinic Patient Portal & Services

> Comprehensive patient care platform integrating MyChart portal, provider search, appointment scheduling, and medical reference resources across Cleveland Clinic's network.

Cleveland Clinic's patient-facing website provides integrated access to healthcare services, medical information, and administrative resources for patients and healthcare professionals. The site serves as a hub for appointment management, provider discovery, health education, and patient support across multiple Cleveland Clinic locations in Ohio, Florida, and Nevada.

## Key Topics

- MyChart Patient Portal
- Appointment Scheduling
- Provider Search
- Medical Reference Library
- Diseases & Conditions
- Treatments & Procedures
- Diagnostics & Testing
- Drugs, Devices & Supplements
- Body Systems & Organs
- Symptoms Lookup
- Virtual Visits
- Patient Care Resources
- Cleveland Clinic Locations
- Medical Professionals Network
- Health Education

## Patient Portal & Appointments

- [MyChart | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/online-services/mychart): MyChart patient portal for medical records, appointments and messaging
- [Appointments | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/patients/information/access): Appointment scheduling and virtual visit access via MyChart
- [Patients and Visitors | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/patients): Patient information, visitor guide, appointments and billing resources

## Provider & Service Directory

- [Find a Provider | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/providers): Provider search and physician directory for finding doctors at Cleveland Clinic
- [Services | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/services): Healthcare services and medical specialties across Cleveland Clinic locations
- [Resources for Medical Professionals | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/professionals): Resources for medical professionals including referrals and clinical network

## Medical Reference & Health Library

- [Medical Questions & Answers | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health): Health library with medical Q&A, symptoms and conditions from Cleveland Clinic
- [Diseases & Conditions | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases): Searchable directory of diseases, conditions, treatments and diagnostics
- [Treatments | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/treatments): Medical treatments directory with risks, benefits and therapy information
- [Procedures | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/procedures): A-Z index of medical procedures and healthcare information resources
- [Diagnostics & Testing | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diagnostics): A-Z directory of diagnostic and testing procedures at Cleveland Clinic
- [Symptoms | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/symptoms): A-Z symptom lookup and medical reference guide from Cleveland Clinic
- [Body Systems & Organs | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/body): A-Z reference guide to body systems and organs with medical information
- [Drugs, Devices & Supplements | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/drugs): Searchable database of drugs, medical devices and supplements reference

## Patient Support & Resources

- [Frequently Asked Questions: Get Answers Fast | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/help): FAQ and help center for appointments, billing, insurance and patient support
- [Cleveland Clinic: Every Life Deserves World Class Care](https://my.clevelandclinic.org): Cleveland Clinic homepage with MyChart patient portal and healthcare services

## Optional

- [Construction Alerts | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/locations/construction-alerts): Construction alerts for Cleveland Clinic locations and parking updates
- [Give to Cleveland Clinic | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/giving): Donation and charitable giving options for Cleveland Clinic support
